system.skills: Astral, Athletics, Close Combat, Exotic Ranged Weapon, Perception
system.powers: Accident, Astral Form, Confusion, Elemental Attack (Fire), Energy
system.description: (Fire, Force 5) Suttees are predatory, feline elementals. When hunting, their fur is coal black, blending into ash wastes. As they approach their prey, they sheathe glowing-hot, scythe-shaped claws fangs. Suttees then leap with ferocity, manifesting a great flaming mane.
